text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—!? My body feels... so hot all of a 
sudden...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Could this be a gift from the Three 
Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The bond you've helped forge for me... 
I'll carry it forward from here on out♪
